description: Search Codemate's website: service pages, client case studies and articles. Returns the best-matching titles with their URLs and a one-line summary. Use this to find out what Codemate does, which industries and technologies it has delivered in, or whether it has written about a topic.

kind.description: Restrict to one kind: "reference" for client case studies, "article" for published articles, "page" for service and product pages. Omit to search all three.

lang.description: Which language edition of the site to answer from. Defaults to English.

name: search_site
